items.feedbackWrong: Modal Passive: must + be + V3. Không phải 'must taken' hay 'must be take'. 'Take' → V3 = taken.
items.ieltsTip: Câu kết Task 2 cực mạnh: 'Urgent/Immediate measures must be taken to + V...' — học thuộc cụm này!

writingMini.prompt: Viết 1-2 câu Task 2 về vấn đề ô nhiễm nhựa dùng Passive Voice. Không dùng 'people' làm chủ ngữ.
writingMini.placeholder: Ví dụ: Millions of tonnes of plastic waste are discarded every year...
writingMini.modelAnswer: Millions of tonnes of plastic waste are discarded into oceans every year, and marine ecosystems have been severely damaged as a result.

speakingDrill.prompt: IELTS Speaking Part 3 — 'What actions have been taken by governments to address environmental issues?' Trả lời 2-3 câu dùng Passive Voice.
speakingDrill.modelAnswer: Various measures have been taken by governments worldwide to tackle environmental problems. For example, carbon taxes have been introduced in several European countries, and international agreements like the Paris Accord have been signed by over 190 nations. However, critics argue that more decisive action must be taken if meaningful progress is to be made.

completion.nextUnitConnection: Bạn đã nắm Passive — cấu trúc quan trọng nhất của Writing. Unit 11 bắt đầu chương Câu Điều Kiện — ba loại conditional là thử thách lớn nhất với học viên muốn lên band 6.5+.

title: Conditional Type 1
subtitle: Câu điều kiện loại 1 — Có thật ở hiện tại/tương lai

meta.prevUnitConnection: Bạn đã nắm Passive Voice. Conditional Type 1 là cấu trúc lập luận nhân-quả then chốt trong Task 2.

formation.affirmative: If + Simple Present, will/can/may + V (base form)
formation.negative: If + S + do/does not + V, S + will not + V
formation.question: What will happen if + S + V (Simple Present)?

theory.coreRule: Conditional Type 1: IF + Simple Present, will + V nguyên mẫu. Tình huống CÓ THỂ xảy ra. Biến thể: If + Present, can/may/might + V. KHÔNG dùng will trong mệnh đề if.

quickExamples.en: If world leaders fail to reach a climate agreement, global temperatures will continue to rise.
quickExamples.vi: Nếu các nhà lãnh đạo không đạt được thỏa thuận, nhiệt độ toàn cầu sẽ tiếp tục tăng.

quickExamples.en: Economic inequality will worsen if governments do not increase investment in education.
quickExamples.vi: Bất bình đẳng sẽ tồi tệ hơn nếu chính phủ không tăng đầu tư giáo dục.

quickExamples.en: If countries cooperate on trade policies, both economies may benefit significantly.
quickExamples.vi: Nếu các quốc gia hợp tác về thương mại, cả hai nền kinh tế có thể hưởng lợi.

keyPoints: Dùng Conditional Type 1 trong Part 3 để lập luận nhân quả về các vấn đề toàn cầu.
Dùng Conditional Type 1 trong Task 2 để đề xuất giải pháp và dự đoán kết quả — đặc trưng band 6.0+.

contrastExamples.wrong: If governments will invest in renewable energy, carbon emissions will decrease.
contrastExamples.correct: If governments invest in renewable energy, carbon emissions will decrease significantly.
contrastExamples.tipVi: KHÔNG BAO GIỜ dùng 'will' trong mệnh đề 'if'. Mệnh đề if dùng Simple Present dù nói về tương lai.
contrastExamples.bandImpact: Lỗi 'if + will' trong Task 2 là lỗi cơ bản — giám khảo sẽ không cho quá band 5.5 về Grammatical Accuracy.

contrastExamples.wrong: If the pollution level will rise, marine life will be threatened.
contrastExamples.correct: If the pollution level rises, marine life will be threatened.
contrastExamples.tipVi: Mệnh đề if dùng Simple Present (rises), không dùng will.

contrastExamples.wrong: Countries will suffer if they won't reduce carbon emissions.
contrastExamples.correct: Countries will suffer if they do not reduce carbon emissions.
contrastExamples.tipVi: Phủ định trong mệnh đề if: do not/does not, không dùng won't.

contrastExamples.wrong: If we takes action now, the situation might improve.
contrastExamples.correct: If we take action now, the situation might improve.
contrastExamples.tipVi: We = số nhiều → take (không thêm -s).

items.question: Câu Conditional Type 1 nào đúng?
options: If the government will act quickly, the crisis will be avoided.
If the government acts quickly, the crisis will be avoided.
If the government acts quickly, the crisis would be avoided.
If the government act quickly, the crisis will be avoided.
items.correctAnswer: If the government acts quickly, the crisis will be avoided.
items.feedbackCorrect: Đúng! If + Simple Present (acts — ngôi 3 số ít thêm -s) + will + V nguyên mẫu. Không có will trong mệnh đề if.
items.feedbackWrong: Type 1: If + Simple Present (không will, không would) + will + V. Government ngôi 3 số ít → acts.
items.ieltsTip: Conditional Type 1 Part 3: If + action → consequence will follow. Luôn nhớ: NO WILL in the if-clause.

items.question: Hoàn thành câu Task 2: 'Economic growth _____ if developing nations _____ access to advanced technology.'
options: will accelerate / gain
will accelerate / will gain
would accelerate / gain
accelerates / gain
items.correctAnswer: will accelerate / gain
items.feedbackCorrect: 'Will accelerate' ở mệnh đề chính. 'Gain' (Simple Present) ở mệnh đề if. Type 1 hoàn chỉnh.
items.feedbackWrong: Mệnh đề chính: will + V. Mệnh đề if: Simple Present (không will, không would).
items.ieltsTip: Lập luận Task 2: '[Result] will happen if [condition] [Simple Present].'

items.question: Sửa lỗi: 'If countries will not reduce plastic waste, the ocean will become uninhabitable for marine species.'
options: will not reduce → do not reduce
will not reduce → would not reduce
will become → would become
Câu đúng, không cần sửa.
items.correctAnswer: will not reduce → do not reduce
items.feedbackCorrect: 'Will not reduce' trong mệnh đề if sai → 'do not reduce' (Simple Present phủ định).
items.feedbackWrong: Phủ định trong mệnh đề if: do not/does not — không dùng won't/will not.
items.ieltsTip: If + don't/doesn't + V (không won't). Mệnh đề chính mới dùng will/won't.

items.question: Điền đúng: 'If more nations _____ (sign) the trade agreement, global poverty _____ (likely / reduce) significantly.'
options: sign / will likely be reduced
will sign / will likely be reduced
sign / is likely reduced
signs / will likely reduce
items.correctAnswer: sign / will likely be reduced
items.feedbackCorrect: 'Sign' (Simple Present, số nhiều — không -s) trong if. 'Will likely be reduced' = Passive tương lai + likely. Kết hợp Conditional + Passive + likely = band 6.5!
items.feedbackWrong: If-clause: Simple Present sign (nations số nhiều, không -s). Main clause: will + likely + be reduced (Passive).
items.ieltsTip: Kết hợp Type 1 + Passive: 'If... [Simple Present], [result] will be + V3' — rất học thuật.

items.question: Tạo câu Task 2: [education / if / invest / governments / quality / will / in / narrow / the / wealth / gap / more]
options: If governments invest more in quality education, the wealth gap will narrow.
If governments will invest more in quality education, the wealth gap will narrow.
If governments invest more in quality education, the wealth gap narrows.
The wealth gap will narrow if governments will invest more in quality education.
items.correctAnswer: If governments invest more in quality education, the wealth gap will narrow.
items.feedbackCorrect: Câu Task 2 lập luận hoàn hảo! If + invest (Simple Present, không will) → will + narrow. Band 6.0+!
items.feedbackWrong: Type 1: If + Simple Present (invest — không will) → will + V nguyên mẫu (narrow).
items.ieltsTip: Bắt đầu đoạn kết Task 2: 'If [solution is implemented], [positive result] will [occur].' — cấu trúc kết bài band 6.0+.

writingMini.prompt: Viết 1-2 câu Task 2 dùng Conditional Type 1 đề xuất giải pháp cho vấn đề toàn cầu.
writingMini.placeholder: Ví dụ: If wealthier nations increase foreign aid, developing countries will...
writingMini.modelAnswer: If wealthier nations increase foreign aid and share technological expertise, developing countries will be able to build stronger economies and reduce poverty rates.

speakingDrill.prompt: Part 3: 'What will happen if countries don't cooperate on global issues?' Dùng Conditional Type 1.
speakingDrill.modelAnswer: If countries fail to cooperate on global poverty, inequality will increase and social unrest may spread across many regions. However, if wealthier nations commit to fairer trade policies, the situation can improve significantly within a generation.

completion.nextUnitConnection: Type 1 = có thể xảy ra. Type 2 = KHÔNG CÓ THẬT ở hiện tại — dùng để lập luận giả thuyết trong Task 2.

title: Conditional Type 2
subtitle: Câu điều kiện loại 2 — Không có thật ở hiện tại

meta.prevUnitConnection: Type 1 nói về tình huống có thể xảy ra. Type 2 nói về tình huống KHÔNG CÓ THẬT.

formation.affirmative: If + Past Simple, would/could/might + V (base form)
formation.negative: If + S + did not + V, S + would not + V
formation.question: What would happen if + S + Past Simple?

theory.coreRule: Conditional Type 2: IF + Past Simple, would + V nguyên mẫu. Tình huống KHÔNG CÓ THẬT ở hiện tại/tương lai. Đặc biệt: If I/he/she/it were... (văn trang trọng dùng were). KHÔNG dùng would trong mệnh đề if.

quickExamples.en: If world leaders were more united, global problems would be easier to solve.
quickExamples.vi: Nếu các nhà lãnh đạo đoàn kết hơn, các vấn đề toàn cầu sẽ dễ giải quyết hơn.

quickExamples.en: If I were the prime minister, I would prioritize investment in renewable energy.
quickExamples.vi: Nếu tôi là thủ tướng, tôi sẽ ưu tiên đầu tư vào năng lượng tái tạo.

quickExamples.en: Developing nations could catch up economically if they received more equitable trade opportunities.
quickExamples.vi: Các nước đang phát triển có thể bắt kịp nếu nhận được cơ hội thương mại công bằng hơn.

keyPoints: Dùng Type 2 trong Part 3 để đưa ra ý kiến giả thuyết — thể hiện tư duy phân tích cao.
Dùng Type 2 trong Task 2 để lập luận về tình huống lý tưởng hoặc phản biện.

contrastExamples.wrong: If every country would reduce emissions by 50%, climate change would slow.
contrastExamples.correct: If every country reduced emissions by 50%, climate change would slow significantly.
contrastExamples.tipVi: KHÔNG dùng 'would' trong mệnh đề 'if' của Type 2. Mệnh đề if dùng Past Simple.
contrastExamples.bandImpact: Phân biệt đúng Type 1 (if + present) và Type 2 (if + past) là điều kiện để đạt Grammatical Range band 6.5.

contrastExamples.wrong: If I was the president, I will change immigration policies.
contrastExamples.correct: If I were the president, I would change immigration policies.
contrastExamples.tipVi: Type 2: if-clause dùng were (văn trang trọng). Mệnh đề chính: would (not will).

contrastExamples.wrong: If countries would cooperate more, poverty would decrease.
contrastExamples.correct: If countries cooperated more, poverty would decrease.
contrastExamples.tipVi: KHÔNG dùng would trong mệnh đề if — lỗi cực phổ biến. Dùng Past Simple.

contrastExamples.wrong: The world would be safer if tensions between nations will reduce.
contrastExamples.correct: The world would be safer if tensions between nations reduced.
contrastExamples.tipVi: Dù if-clause đứng sau mệnh đề chính — vẫn phải dùng Past Simple (reduced).

items.question: Câu Conditional Type 2 nào đúng?
options: If more people would use public transport, air pollution would decrease.
If more people used public transport, air pollution would decrease.
If more people use public transport, air pollution would decrease.
If more people used public transport, air pollution will decrease.
items.correctAnswer: If more people used public transport, air pollution would decrease.
items.feedbackCorrect: Đúng! Type 2: If + Past Simple (used) + would + V nguyên mẫu (decrease). Giả thuyết — hiện tại không đủ người dùng phương tiện công cộng.
items.feedbackWrong: Type 2: If + Past Simple (used — không would, không use) + would + V. Không dùng will trong câu chính của Type 2.
items.ieltsTip: Nhận biết Type 2: câu nói về tình huống NGƯỢC LẠI thực tế. 'If I were richer' = nhưng thực ra tôi không giàu.

items.question: Part 3 — 'If you could change one thing about global economic policy, what would it be?' Câu trả lời nào đúng?
options: If I can change one thing, I will reduce trade barriers.
If I could change one thing, I would reduce trade barriers between developing nations.
If I would change one thing, I would reduce trade barriers.
If I changed one thing, I will reduce trade barriers.
items.correctAnswer: If I could change one thing, I would reduce trade barriers between developing nations.
items.feedbackCorrect: 'If I could' = giả thuyết (could = Past Simple của can). 'I would reduce' = mệnh đề chính. Câu trả lời Part 3 band 6.0!
items.feedbackWrong: Type 2: If + Past Simple/could (giả thuyết) + would + V. 'If I could' là dạng giả thuyết lịch sự.
items.ieltsTip: Part 3 hay hỏi 'If you could..., what would you...?' Học thuộc: 'If I could + V, I would + V because...'

items.question: Sửa lỗi: 'If wealthy nations would share their medical technology, developing countries would overcome health crises more effectively. If there was more international solidarity, fewer people will die.'
options: would share → shared; will die → would die; was → were
would share → shared only
will die → would die only
Câu đúng, không cần sửa.
items.correctAnswer: would share → shared; will die → would die; was → were
items.feedbackCorrect: Ba điểm: (1) would share → shared (if-clause dùng Past Simple). (2) will die → would die (mệnh đề chính Type 2). (3) was → were (văn trang trọng).
items.feedbackWrong: Type 2 toàn câu: if-clause = Past Simple (not would), main clause = would (not will). 'If there were' dùng were thay was trong văn học thuật.
items.ieltsTip: 'If there were more...' (not was) là chuẩn trong Task 2 học thuật — dùng 'were' cho mọi chủ ngữ trong văn viết trang trọng.

items.question: Điền đúng: 'If the international community _____ (adopt) a unified approach to cybersecurity, global digital infrastructure _____ (be) far more secure.'
options: adopted / would be
would adopt / would be
adopts / would be
adopted / will be
items.correctAnswer: adopted / would be
items.feedbackCorrect: 'Adopted' = Past Simple trong if-clause (Type 2). 'Would be' = kết quả giả thuyết. Câu Task 2 học thuật!
items.feedbackWrong: Type 2: if + Past Simple (adopted — không would adopt) + would + V (would be — không will be).
items.ieltsTip: Type 2 trong Task 2 phù hợp để nói về tình huống lý tưởng: 'If [ideal condition existed], [positive outcome] would follow.'

items.question: Tạo câu Part 3: [were / nations / all / if / committed / equality / gender / to / be / disparities / global / would / reduce]
options: If all nations were committed to gender equality, global disparities would reduce.
If all nations would be committed to gender equality, global disparities would reduce.
If all nations were committed to gender equality, global disparities will reduce.
All nations if were committed to gender equality, global disparities would reduce.
items.correctAnswer: If all nations were committed to gender equality, global disparities would reduce.
items.feedbackCorrect: Hoàn hảo! 'Were committed' = Past Simple Passive trong if-clause (Type 2). 'Would reduce' = mệnh đề chính. Band 6.5+!
items.feedbackWrong: Type 2: if + were committed (Past Simple Passive — không would be) + would + V (reduce — không will).
items.ieltsTip: Kết hợp Type 2 + Passive: 'If + were/were + V3 + ..., would + V' — ngữ pháp rất phức tạp và ấn tượng.

writingMini.prompt: Viết 1-2 câu Task 2 dùng Type 2 về tình huống lý tưởng trong quan hệ quốc tế.
writingMini.placeholder: Ví dụ: If richer nations reduced their carbon footprints, developing countries would...
writingMini.modelAnswer: If richer nations reduced their carbon footprints drastically, developing countries would have more room to grow their economies without bearing the full burden of climate responsibility.

speakingDrill.prompt: Part 3: 'If you were a world leader, what global problem would you prioritize?' Dùng Type 2.
speakingDrill.modelAnswer: If I were a world leader, I would make climate change my top priority. I would push for a binding international agreement requiring all major economies to transition to renewable energy within 20 years. If such a commitment existed, I believe we would have a genuinely sustainable future.

completion.nextUnitConnection: Type 2 = không có thật hiện tại. Type 3 = không có thật trong QUÁ KHỨ — nói về điều đã không xảy ra. Đây là cấu trúc phức tạp nhất.

title: Conditional Type 3
subtitle: Câu điều kiện loại 3 — Không có thật trong quá khứ

meta.prevUnitConnection: Type 2 = giả thuyết hiện tại. Type 3 = hối tiếc về quá khứ.

formation.affirmative: If + Past Perfect (had + V3), would/could/might + have + V3
formation.negative: If + S + had not + V3, S + would not + have + V3
formation.question: What would have happened if + S + had + V3?

theory.coreRule: Conditional Type 3: IF + Past Perfect (had + V3), would/could/might + have + V3. Diễn đạt tình huống KHÔNG CÓ THẬT trong QUÁ KHỨ. Biến thể mệnh đề chính: could have + V3, might have + V3.

quickExamples.en: If earlier generations had prioritized environmental protection, we would not have faced such severe climate crises.
quickExamples.vi: Nếu các thế hệ trước đã ưu tiên bảo vệ môi trường, chúng ta đã không phải đối mặt với khủng hoảng khí hậu nghiêm trọng.

quickExamples.en: The 2008 financial crisis could have been avoided if regulators had imposed stricter controls.
quickExamples.vi: Cuộc khủng hoảng 2008 đã có thể tránh được nếu cơ quan quản lý áp đặt kiểm soát chặt chẽ hơn.

quickExamples.en: Millions of lives might have been saved if international aid had reached affected regions sooner.
quickExamples.vi: Hàng triệu sinh mạng đã có thể được cứu nếu viện trợ quốc tế đến sớm hơn.

keyPoints: Dùng Type 3 trong Part 3 để phân tích sai lầm lịch sử — thể hiện tư duy phân tích sâu, band 6.5+.
Dùng Type 3 trong Task 2 để lập luận nguyên nhân-kết quả trong quá khứ — cấu trúc phức tạp nhất.

contrastExamples.wrong: If countries had acted earlier on climate change, the situation would be much better now.
contrastExamples.correct: If countries had acted earlier on climate change, the situation would have been much better.
contrastExamples.tipVi: Type 3 phải nhất quán: if-clause dùng Past Perfect (had acted) → mệnh đề chính dùng would HAVE + V3. 'Would be' là Type 2 — trộn hai loại là lỗi phổ biến.
contrastExamples.bandImpact: Dùng đúng Type 3 hoàn chỉnh là dấu hiệu Grammatical Range band 6.5–7.0.

contrastExamples.wrong: If they had prepared better, they would avoid the crisis.
contrastExamples.correct: If they had prepared better, they would have avoided the crisis.
contrastExamples.tipVi: Type 3 phải nhất quán: if + had + V3, would + HAVE + V3. Không dùng 'would avoid' (Type 2).

contrastExamples.wrong: If the treaty would have been signed earlier, more countries could participate.
contrastExamples.correct: If the treaty had been signed earlier, more countries could have participated.
contrastExamples.tipVi: If-clause Type 3: 'had been signed' (không 'would have been'). Mệnh đề chính: could have participated.

contrastExamples.wrong: The disaster might avoided if the government has warned citizens earlier.
contrastExamples.correct: The disaster might have been avoided if the government had warned citizens earlier.
contrastExamples.tipVi: Mệnh đề chính: might + have + been + V3. If-clause: had + V3. Hai vế phải nhất quán.

items.question: Câu Conditional Type 3 nào đúng?
options: If the UN had intervened sooner, the conflict would be prevented.
If the UN had intervened sooner, the conflict would have been prevented.
If the UN would have intervened sooner, the conflict would be prevented.
If the UN intervened sooner, the conflict would have been prevented.
items.correctAnswer: If the UN had intervened sooner, the conflict would have been prevented.
items.feedbackCorrect: Đúng! Type 3: if + had intervened (Past Perfect) + would have been prevented (Passive would + have + V3).
items.feedbackWrong: Type 3: if + Past Perfect (had + V3) + would have + V3. Cả hai vế phải dùng 'have'. Không dùng 'would have' trong mệnh đề if.
items.ieltsTip: Dấu hiệu nhận biết Type 3: 'had + V3' trong mệnh đề if, 'would/could/might + have + V3' trong mệnh đề chính.

items.question: Câu Task 2 nào phân tích đúng nguyên nhân khủng hoảng 2008?
options: The 2008 crisis could be avoided if banks would have been regulated more strictly.
The 2008 crisis could have been avoided if banks had been regulated more strictly.
The 2008 crisis could have been avoided if banks were regulated more strictly.
The 2008 crisis would avoid if banks had been regulated more strictly.
items.correctAnswer: The 2008 crisis could have been avoided if banks had been regulated more strictly.
items.feedbackCorrect: 'Could have been avoided' = Passive Type 3. 'Had been regulated' = Past Perfect Passive trong if-clause. Câu Task 2 phân tích lịch sử band 6.5!
items.feedbackWrong: Type 3 + Passive: mệnh đề chính = could/would + have + been + V3. If-clause = had + been + V3. Không dùng 'would have' trong if-clause.
items.ieltsTip: Type 3 + Passive: 'could have been [prevented/avoided] if [subject] had [done something]' — phổ biến trong Task 2 phân tích lịch sử.

items.question: Sửa lỗi: 'If colonial powers had not exploited developing nations, those countries might have develop stronger economies. Many global inequalities would not existed today.'
options: might have develop → might have developed; would not existed → would not have existed
might have develop → might developed; would not existed đúng
Chỉ might have develop → might have developed
Câu đúng, không cần sửa.
items.correctAnswer: might have develop → might have developed; would not existed → would not have existed
items.feedbackCorrect: Hai lỗi: (1) 'might have develop' → 'might have developed' (modal + have + V3). (2) 'would not existed' → 'would not have existed' (thiếu 'have').
items.feedbackWrong: Type 3 mệnh đề chính: modal + have + V3. 'Might have develop' thiếu -d. 'Would not existed' thiếu 'have'.
items.ieltsTip: Lỗi phổ biến Type 3: quên 'have' sau modal: 'would existed' → 'would have existed'. Luôn kiểm tra: modal + HAVE + V3.

items.question: Điền đúng: 'If global leaders _____ (take) decisive action on inequality in the 1990s, the wealth gap we see today _____ (might / not / become) so extreme.'
options: had taken / might not have become
had taken / might not become
would have taken / might not have become
had taken / might not became
items.correctAnswer: had taken / might not have become
items.feedbackCorrect: 'Had taken' = Past Perfect trong if-clause. 'Might not have become' = modal + not + have + V3. Type 3 hoàn chỉnh!
items.feedbackWrong: If-clause: had + V3 (had taken — không 'would have taken'). Main clause: might + not + have + V3 (become — V3 của become = become).
items.ieltsTip: V3 của 'become' = 'become' (giống V1). Nên 'might have become' đúng, không phải 'might have became'.

items.question: Tạo câu Task 2: [invested / developed / nations / had / clean / in / energy / earlier / carbon / emissions / would / significantly / have / fallen]
options: If developed nations had invested in clean energy earlier, carbon emissions would have fallen significantly.
If developed nations would have invested in clean energy earlier, carbon emissions would have fallen significantly.
If developed nations had invested in clean energy earlier, carbon emissions would fallen significantly.
Developed nations had invested in clean energy earlier, carbon emissions would have fallen significantly.
items.correctAnswer: If developed nations had invested in clean energy earlier, carbon emissions would have fallen significantly.
items.feedbackCorrect: Type 3 hoàn hảo! If + had invested (Past Perfect — không 'would have invested') + would have fallen (would + have + V3, V3 của fall = fallen). Band 7.0!
items.feedbackWrong: If-clause: had invested (không 'would have invested'). Main clause: would + have + fallen (V3 của fall = fallen).
items.ieltsTip: Type 3 Task 2: 'If [subject] had [V3], [result] would have [V3].' Dùng trong kết bài phân tích nguyên nhân lịch sử.

writingMini.prompt: Viết 1-2 câu Task 2 dùng Type 3 phân tích sai lầm lịch sử. Chủ đề: môi trường hoặc kinh tế.
writingMini.placeholder: Ví dụ: If world governments had signed a binding climate agreement in the 1990s...
writingMini.modelAnswer: If world governments had signed a binding climate agreement in the 1990s, global temperatures would not have risen as dramatically, and the costs of climate adaptation would have been far lower.

speakingDrill.prompt: Part 3: 'What could the international community have done differently to prevent current global problems?' Dùng Type 3.
speakingDrill.modelAnswer: If earlier generations had taken climate change more seriously, we would not have faced the environmental crises we see today. Governments could have invested in renewable energy decades ago, creating a much cleaner economy. Had international cooperation been stronger, many of today's conflicts might have been avoided entirely.

completion.nextUnitConnection: Bạn đã nắm cả 3 loại Conditional! Unit 14 — Relative Clauses — dạy mở rộng câu bằng who/which/that — chìa khóa viết câu dài, học thuật.

meta.prevUnitConnection: Bạn đã nắm Conditional. Relative Clauses là cách MỞ RỘNG câu — kết hợp hai kỹ năng này tạo câu Task 2 rất ấn tượng.

theory.coreRule: Relative Clauses dùng: WHO (người — chủ ngữ/tân ngữ), WHICH (vật/sự việc), THAT (người hoặc vật trong defining clauses), WHOSE (sở hữu), WHERE (nơi chốn). Defining (không dấu phẩy, dùng that): 'The policy that was introduced...' Non-defining (có dấu phẩy, không dùng that): 'Climate change, which affects all nations, requires...'

quickExamples.en: Developing nations, which often lack resources to adapt, are most vulnerable to climate change.
quickExamples.vi: Các quốc gia đang phát triển, thường thiếu nguồn lực, dễ bị tổn thương nhất bởi biến đổi khí hậu.

quickExamples.en: The Paris Agreement, which was signed by 196 parties, represents a milestone in global cooperation.
quickExamples.vi: Hiệp định Paris, được ký bởi 196 bên, là cột mốc quan trọng trong hợp tác toàn cầu.

quickExamples.en: Communities where economic opportunities are limited tend to have higher emigration rates.
quickExamples.vi: Các cộng đồng thiếu cơ hội kinh tế có xu hướng có tỷ lệ di cư cao hơn.

keyPoints: Dùng Relative Clauses để mô tả chi tiết trong Part 3 — gộp hai câu ngắn thành một câu phức hợp tự nhiên.
Dùng Relative Clauses trong Task 2 để viết câu phức tạp, tránh lặp từ — đặc trưng band 6.5+.

contrastExamples.wrong: Countries which they are developing need more international support.
contrastExamples.correct: Countries that are developing need more international support.
contrastExamples.tipVi: Sau đại từ quan hệ (who/which/that), KHÔNG lặp lại đại từ chủ ngữ. 'Countries which they are...' thừa 'they' — lỗi đặc trưng người Việt.
contrastExamples.bandImpact: Lỗi lặp đại từ trong mệnh đề quan hệ ('which it is', 'who he is') là lỗi điển hình dưới band 6.0.

contrastExamples.wrong: The agreement which it was signed in 2015 has been widely praised.
contrastExamples.correct: The agreement which was signed in 2015 has been widely praised.
contrastExamples.tipVi: Sau 'which' không cần 'it'. 'Which' ĐÃ là chủ ngữ — thêm 'it' là thừa và sai.

contrastExamples.wrong: The scientists that they discovered the vaccine received a Nobel Prize.
contrastExamples.correct: The scientists who discovered the vaccine received a Nobel Prize.
contrastExamples.tipVi: Người → dùng 'who', không phải 'that they'. Không lặp 'they' sau 'who'.

contrastExamples.wrong: This is the country where I have visited it many times.
contrastExamples.correct: This is the country that I have visited many times.
contrastExamples.tipVi: 'Visit' cần tân ngữ trực tiếp → dùng 'that/which', không phải 'where'. Và không lặp 'it'.

items.question: Câu nào dùng đúng mệnh đề quan hệ?
options: Refugees which they flee war deserve international protection.
Refugees who flee war deserve international protection.
Refugees who they flee war deserve international protection.
Refugees that they flee war deserve international protection.
items.correctAnswer: Refugees who flee war deserve international protection.
items.feedbackCorrect: Người → 'who'. Sau 'who' không lặp 'they'. 'Who flee' = mệnh đề xác định.
items.feedbackWrong: Người → 'who' (không 'which'). Không lặp 'they' sau 'who'.
items.ieltsTip: NGƯỜI → who/whom/whose. VẬT/SỰ VIỆC → which/that. Không bao giờ lặp đại từ sau đại từ quan hệ.

items.question: Câu Task 2 nào dùng mệnh đề quan hệ học thuật nhất?
options: Globalization has benefits and it has created economic opportunities for millions.
Globalization, which has created economic opportunities for millions, also has significant drawbacks.
Globalization that has created economic opportunities for millions, also has significant drawbacks.
Globalization, which it has created economic opportunities for millions, also has drawbacks.
items.correctAnswer: Globalization, which has created economic opportunities for millions, also has significant drawbacks.
items.feedbackCorrect: Non-defining clause: dấu phẩy + which (không 'that') + mệnh đề bổ sung. Gộp hai ý vào một câu — band 6.5.
items.feedbackWrong: Non-defining (bổ sung): dấu phẩy + which (không that). Không lặp 'it' sau 'which'.
items.ieltsTip: Non-defining (có dấu phẩy): luôn dùng which, không that. Thêm thông tin bổ sung không thiết yếu.

items.question: Sửa lỗi: 'Nations that they have strong social safety nets tend to have lower poverty rates. This is an approach which it has been proven effective in Scandinavian countries.'
options: that they have → that have; which it has → which has
that they have → which they have; which it has → which has
Chỉ which it has → which has
Câu đúng, không cần sửa.
items.correctAnswer: that they have → that have; which it has → which has
items.feedbackCorrect: Hai lỗi cùng kiểu: lặp đại từ sau đại từ quan hệ. 'That have', 'which has' — không thêm 'they/it'.
items.feedbackWrong: Cùng một lỗi lặp lại: [that/which] + [they/it] là sai. Đại từ quan hệ ĐÃ là chủ ngữ.
items.ieltsTip: Lỗi cực phổ biến của người Việt: 'which it is' / 'that they have' — kiểm tra kỹ mỗi khi dùng mệnh đề quan hệ.

items.question: Điền đúng đại từ quan hệ: 'The communities _____ are most affected by poverty are often located in regions _____ investment is severely lacking, and _____ residents have limited access to education.'
options: that / where / whose
which / where / who
who / which / whose
that / which / whose
items.correctAnswer: that / where / whose
items.feedbackCorrect: 'That' (defining, chủ ngữ). 'Where' (nơi chốn). 'Whose' (sở hữu — residents of communities). Ba đại từ quan hệ trong một câu — band 7.0!
items.feedbackWrong: 'That' = defining cho communities. 'Where' = nơi thiếu investment. 'Whose' = sở hữu (residents OF communities).
items.ieltsTip: Bộ ba nâng cao: that (xác định), where (nơi chốn), whose (sở hữu) — học thuộc để đạt band 6.5+.

items.question: Gộp hai câu: [International aid organizations have worked in conflict zones for decades] + [they often operate under dangerous conditions]
options: International aid organizations, which have been working in conflict zones for decades, often operate under dangerous conditions.
International aid organizations, that have been working in conflict zones for decades, often operate under dangerous conditions.
International aid organizations which they have been working in conflict zones for decades often operate under dangerous conditions.
International aid organizations, which have been working in conflict zones for decades, which often operate under dangerous conditions.
items.correctAnswer: International aid organizations, which have been working in conflict zones for decades, often operate under dangerous conditions.
items.feedbackCorrect: Non-defining clause (bổ sung → dấu phẩy + which). Không lặp 'they' sau 'which'. Mệnh đề quan hệ + Present Perfect = band 7.0!
items.feedbackWrong: Non-defining: dấu phẩy + which (không that). Không lặp 'they'. Chủ mệnh đề (operate) tiếp tục sau mệnh đề quan hệ.
items.ieltsTip: Mệnh đề non-defining: [Subject], which [extra info], [main verb]. Dấu phẩy thứ hai đóng mệnh đề.

writingMini.prompt: Viết 1-2 câu Task 2 về di cư toàn cầu dùng mệnh đề quan hệ. Gộp hai ý vào một câu.
writingMini.placeholder: Ví dụ: Many migrants, who leave their home countries in search of better opportunities, face...
writingMini.modelAnswer: Many migrants, who leave their home countries in search of better economic opportunities, face significant cultural barriers in their destination countries, which often lack adequate integration programs.

speakingDrill.prompt: Part 3: 'What challenges do international migrants face?' Dùng ít nhất một mệnh đề quan hệ.
speakingDrill.modelAnswer: Migrants face numerous challenges, which vary by destination country. Language barriers are obstacles that prevent newcomers from fully integrating. Many migrants come from cultures where family ties are very strong, which makes it difficult to adapt to a more individualistic way of life.

completion.nextUnitConnection: Unit 15 — Reported Speech — dạy thuật lại quan điểm của người khác. Quan trọng trong Task 2 khi trích dẫn và trong Speaking khi kể chuyện.

meta.prevUnitConnection: Relative Clauses mở rộng câu. Reported Speech là cách thuật lại quan điểm của người khác — thiết yếu trong Task 2 dạng 'Some people argue that...'

formation.negative: S + said/told + (that) + S + did not / could not + V
formation.question: S + asked + (if/whether/wh-word) + [backshifted clause]

theory.coreRule: Reported Speech: thay đổi (1) đại từ; (2) thì (backshift): Present→Past, Past→Past Perfect, will→would, can→could, may→might; (3) trạng từ: now→then, today→that day, here→there. Động từ tường thuật: say (that), tell sb (that), argue (that), claim (that), suggest (that), warn (that).

quickExamples.en: The UN Secretary-General argued that immediate action on poverty was essential for global stability.
quickExamples.vi: Tổng thư ký LHQ lập luận rằng hành động ngay lập tức về nghèo đói là thiết yếu.

quickExamples.en: Researchers warned that if deforestation continued, entire ecosystems would collapse within decades.
quickExamples.vi: Các nhà nghiên cứu cảnh báo rằng nếu phá rừng tiếp tục, toàn bộ hệ sinh thái sẽ sụp đổ.

quickExamples.en: Some economists claimed that free trade had created more inequality than prosperity.
quickExamples.vi: Một số nhà kinh tế tuyên bố rằng thương mại tự do đã tạo ra bất bình đẳng nhiều hơn thịnh vượng.

keyPoints: Dùng Reported Speech trong Part 3 để thuật lại quan điểm từ nghiên cứu — nghe thuyết phục và học thuật.
Dùng Reported Speech trong Task 2 để giới thiệu và phản biện quan điểm — đặc trưng bài luận band 6.5+.

contrastExamples.wrong: The researcher said that global inequality is getting worse every year.
contrastExamples.correct: The researcher said that global inequality was getting worse every year.
contrastExamples.tipVi: Khi động từ tường thuật ở quá khứ (said), thì trong mệnh đề phụ phải lùi một thì: 'is getting' → 'was getting'. Người Việt thường quên backshift.
contrastExamples.bandImpact: Backshift đúng trong Reported Speech — dấu hiệu ngữ pháp phức tạp giúp tăng điểm từ 6.0 lên 6.5.

contrastExamples.wrong: The expert told that education was the key to reducing poverty.
contrastExamples.correct: The expert said that education was the key to reducing poverty.
contrastExamples.tipVi: 'Tell' phải có tân ngữ (tell somebody). 'Say' không cần tân ngữ. 'Told that' sai — phải là 'told us that' hoặc 'said that'.

contrastExamples.wrong: She said me that the policy had failed.
contrastExamples.correct: She told me that the policy had failed.
contrastExamples.tipVi: 'Said' không theo sau bởi tân ngữ người. 'Told me' = đúng. 'Said me' = sai.

contrastExamples.wrong: The report claimed that poverty is increasing in rural areas.
contrastExamples.correct: The report claimed that poverty was increasing in rural areas.
contrastExamples.tipVi: Khi 'claimed' ở quá khứ → backshift: 'is increasing' → 'was increasing'.

items.question: Chuyển sang Reported Speech: 'Global inequality is a serious threat to world peace.' (Expert said...)
options: The expert said global inequality is a serious threat to world peace.
The expert said that global inequality was a serious threat to world peace.
The expert told that global inequality was a serious threat to world peace.
The expert said that global inequality is was a threat to world peace.
items.correctAnswer: The expert said that global inequality was a serious threat to world peace.
items.feedbackCorrect: 'Said' (quá khứ) → backshift: 'is' → 'was'. 'Said that' (không 'told that').
items.feedbackWrong: 'Said' quá khứ → 'is' phải lùi thành 'was' (backshift). Dùng 'said that', không 'told that'.
items.ieltsTip: Task 2: 'Experts argue/claim/suggest that...' (present = không backshift). Backshift khi dùng quá khứ: 'argued/claimed that...'

items.question: Câu Task 2 nào đúng khi giới thiệu quan điểm đối lập?
options: However, others argued that free trade can to harm developing economies.
However, others argued that free trade could harm developing economies.
However, others argued that free trade could harmed developing economies.
However, others told that free trade could harm developing economies.
items.correctAnswer: However, others argued that free trade could harm developing economies.
items.feedbackCorrect: 'Argued' (quá khứ) → backshift: 'can' → 'could'. 'Could harm' = modal + V nguyên mẫu. Câu phản biện Task 2 chuẩn!
items.feedbackWrong: Backshift: argued (past) → can → could. Modal + V nguyên mẫu: could harm. 'Argued that' (không 'told that').
items.ieltsTip: Cặp đối lập Task 2: 'Some people argue that... However, others contend that...' — dùng argue/contend/maintain.

items.question: Sửa lỗi: 'The UN report warned that millions of people will face food insecurity if climate action is not taken. It also claimed that developing nations are the most vulnerable.'
options: will face → would face; is not taken → was not taken (are có thể giữ — sự thật chung)
will face → would face; is not taken → was not taken; are → were
will face → would face only
Câu đúng, không cần sửa.
items.correctAnswer: will face → would face; is not taken → was not taken (are có thể giữ — sự thật chung)
items.feedbackCorrect: Backshift: warned → will → would, is not → was not. NHƯNG: 'are vulnerable' có thể giữ nguyên nếu là sự thật chung hiện hữu — đây là ngoại lệ backshift.
items.feedbackWrong: Backshift bắt buộc: will → would, is → was. Ngoại lệ: sự thật chung vẫn đúng ở hiện tại có thể không backshift.
items.ieltsTip: Ngoại lệ backshift: sự thật hiển nhiên/vẫn đúng hiện tại có thể không đổi: 'Scientists said the earth is round' (không 'was round').

items.question: Điền đúng: 'Economists _____ (argue) that globalization _____ (create) both winners and losers, and _____ (warn) that without proper policies, inequality _____ (continue) to rise.'
options: argued / had created / warned / would continue
argued / created / warned / would continue
argue / has created / warn / will continue
argued / creates / warned / continued
items.correctAnswer: argued / had created / warned / would continue
items.feedbackCorrect: 'Argued/warned' = quá khứ. 'Had created' = backshift từ Present Perfect. 'Would continue' = backshift từ will. Reported Speech phức tạp nhất — band 7.0!
items.feedbackWrong: Backshift: argued/warned (past) → create → had created; will continue → would continue.
items.ieltsTip: Bảng backshift: will→would, can→could, may→might, is→was, has→had, is doing→was doing.

items.question: Tạo câu Task 2: [researchers / suggested / that / urban / poverty / was / increasing / rapidly / and / that / governments / should / act / immediately]
options: Researchers suggested that urban poverty was increasing rapidly and that governments should act immediately.
Researchers suggested that urban poverty is increasing rapidly and that governments should act immediately.
Researchers suggested urban poverty was increasing rapidly and governments should to act immediately.
Researchers told that urban poverty was increasing rapidly and governments should act immediately.
items.correctAnswer: Researchers suggested that urban poverty was increasing rapidly and that governments should act immediately.
items.feedbackCorrect: 'Suggested that' (không 'told that'). 'Was increasing' = backshift. 'Should' giữ nguyên. 'That' lặp trước mệnh đề thứ hai — chuẩn học thuật!
items.feedbackWrong: 'Suggested that' (không 'told that'). 'Is increasing' → 'was increasing' (backshift). 'Should act' = modal + V nguyên mẫu (không 'to act').
items.ieltsTip: Thuật lại hai mệnh đề: '[Verb] that [clause 1] and that [clause 2]' — lặp 'that' ở mệnh đề thứ hai là chuẩn học thuật.

writingMini.prompt: Viết 1-2 câu Task 2 thuật lại quan điểm về di cư toàn cầu. Dùng: argued/suggested/claimed + that.
writingMini.placeholder: Ví dụ: Some economists argued that controlled migration was beneficial because...
writingMini.modelAnswer: Some economists argued that controlled migration was economically beneficial, as it helped fill labour shortages in ageing societies and contributed to higher tax revenues.

speakingDrill.prompt: Part 3: 'What do experts say about the causes of global inequality?' Thuật lại quan điểm dùng Reported Speech.
speakingDrill.modelAnswer: Many economists have argued that global inequality stems from historical exploitation and current trade imbalances. A recent UN report suggested that the wealth gap was widening faster than at any point in the past century. Researchers also warned that without significant intervention, the richest one percent would control over half of the world's wealth within a generation.

title: Cleft Sentences
subtitle: Câu chẻ — Cấu trúc nhấn mạnh

meta.prevUnitConnection: Reported Speech thuật lại quan điểm. Cleft Sentences là đỉnh cao — cách nhấn mạnh một yếu tố trong câu. Kỹ thuật nâng cao nhất trong khóa học.

formation.negative: It is not + [emphasis] + that... | What ... is not...
formation.question: Is it + [emphasis] + that...? | What is it that...?

theory.coreRule: Hai loại: (1) IT-cleft: It is/was + [nhấn mạnh] + that/who + [phần còn lại]. VD: 'It is education that holds the key to reducing poverty.' (2) WH-cleft: What + [mệnh đề] + is/was + [nhấn mạnh]. VD: 'What the world needs most is greater international cooperation.' Dùng để nhấn mạnh CHỦ THỂ, HÀNH ĐỘNG, THỜI GIAN, NGUYÊN NHÂN.

quickExamples.en: It is international cooperation, not unilateral action, that offers the most hope for solving global problems.
quickExamples.vi: Chính là hợp tác quốc tế, không phải hành động đơn phương, mang lại hy vọng lớn nhất.

quickExamples.en: What governments urgently need to do is invest more in green infrastructure and public transport.
quickExamples.vi: Điều mà các chính phủ cần gấp làm là đầu tư nhiều hơn vào cơ sở hạ tầng xanh.

quickExamples.en: It was the lack of political will, not the absence of solutions, that allowed poverty to persist.
quickExamples.vi: Chính là sự thiếu ý chí chính trị, không phải thiếu giải pháp, đã khiến nghèo đói kéo dài.

keyPoints: Dùng Cleft Sentences trong Part 3 để nhấn mạnh điểm quan trọng nhất của lập luận — thể hiện khả năng cấu trúc nâng cao tự nhiên.
Dùng Cleft Sentences trong Task 2 để nhấn mạnh giải pháp hoặc nguyên nhân — câu văn ấn tượng, đặc trưng band 7.0.

contrastExamples.wrong: It is education that it reduces poverty most effectively.
contrastExamples.correct: It is education that reduces poverty most effectively.
contrastExamples.tipVi: Sau 'that' trong IT-cleft, KHÔNG lặp lại chủ ngữ. 'That IT reduces' sai vì 'that' đã là đại từ quan hệ làm chủ ngữ.
contrastExamples.bandImpact: Dùng đúng một Cleft Sentence trong Task 2 ngay lập tức tạo ấn tượng tốt — hiếm gặp dưới band 7.0.

contrastExamples.wrong: It is the government that it must take responsibility for inequality.
contrastExamples.correct: It is the government that must take responsibility for inequality.
contrastExamples.tipVi: Sau 'that' trong IT-cleft không lặp lại chủ ngữ. 'That must take' đúng; 'that IT must take' sai.

contrastExamples.wrong: What we need it is more investment in education.
contrastExamples.correct: What we need is more investment in education.
contrastExamples.tipVi: WH-cleft: What + [mệnh đề] + is + [danh từ]. 'What we need IT is' thừa 'it'.

contrastExamples.wrong: It was in 2015 when the Paris Agreement was signed.
contrastExamples.correct: It was in 2015 that the Paris Agreement was signed.
contrastExamples.tipVi: IT-cleft nhấn mạnh thời gian dùng 'that', không phải 'when'.

items.question: Câu IT-cleft nào đúng để nhấn mạnh giải pháp?
options: It is education which breaks the cycle of poverty.
It is education that breaks the cycle of poverty.
It is education that it breaks the cycle of poverty.
It was education which breaks the cycle of poverty.
items.correctAnswer: It is education that breaks the cycle of poverty.
items.feedbackCorrect: Đúng! IT-cleft: It is + [education] + that + [breaks...]. Dùng 'that' (không 'which'). Không lặp 'it' sau 'that'.
items.feedbackWrong: IT-cleft chuẩn: It is/was + [nhấn mạnh] + THAT (không which) + [phần còn lại]. Không lặp chủ ngữ sau 'that'.
items.ieltsTip: IT-cleft dùng 'that' (không 'which' hay 'who') ngay cả khi nhấn mạnh người: 'It is the government that must act.'

items.question: WH-cleft nào đúng và học thuật nhất cho kết bài Task 2?
options: What the world needs it is immediate action on climate change.
What the world needs is immediate and coordinated action on climate change.
Which the world needs is immediate action on climate change.
What the world needs are immediate action on climate change.
items.correctAnswer: What the world needs is immediate and coordinated action on climate change.
items.feedbackCorrect: 'What + clause + is + noun'. 'Action' không đếm được → 'is'. Không có 'it' sau 'needs'. Câu kết Task 2 band 7.0!
items.feedbackWrong: WH-cleft: What + [clause] + is + [noun phrase]. Không có 'it'. 'Action' không đếm được → 'is'. Không dùng 'Which' mở đầu.
items.ieltsTip: Kết luận Task 2: 'What society truly needs is...' / 'What must be done is...' / 'What this suggests is...'

items.question: Sửa lỗi: 'It was the industrial revolution which it transformed global economies. What governments they need to do now is learn from history and act more sustainably.'
options: which it → that; they need → need
which it → that only
which → that; it transformed → transformed
Câu đúng, không cần sửa.
items.correctAnswer: which it → that; they need → need
items.feedbackCorrect: Hai lỗi: (1) IT-cleft dùng 'that', không 'which'. Không lặp 'it'. (2) WH-cleft: 'What governments need' — không lặp 'they' sau 'governments'.
items.feedbackWrong: (1) IT-cleft: 'that' (không 'which'). Không lặp 'it'. (2) WH-cleft: 'governments need' — 'governments' là một phần mệnh đề, không cần 'they'.
items.ieltsTip: Hai lỗi điển hình cleft: lặp đại từ trong IT-cleft (that it) và WH-cleft (governments they). Luôn kiểm tra không có đại từ thừa.

items.question: Điền đúng: 'It _____ the combined effort of governments and citizens _____ will ultimately determine whether we build a more equitable world. What _____ most urgently is greater political commitment.'
options: is / that / is needed
is / which / needed
was / that / is needed
is / that / needs
items.correctAnswer: is / that / is needed
items.feedbackCorrect: IT-cleft: It + IS + [combined effort] + THAT + [will determine]. WH-cleft: What + is needed (Passive). Kết hợp hai loại cleft — band 7.0!
items.feedbackWrong: IT-cleft: It is...that (hiện tại). WH-cleft: 'What is needed' = Passive (được cần đến) — không phải 'What needs'.
items.ieltsTip: WH-cleft + Passive: 'What is needed/required is...' rất hay dùng trong đề xuất giải pháp Task 2.

items.question: Tạo câu Task 2 nhấn mạnh: [international / cooperation / is / it / will / that / solve / global / challenges / not / individual / action / most / effectively]
options: It is international cooperation, not individual action, that will solve global challenges most effectively.
It is international cooperation, not individual action, which will solve global challenges most effectively.
It is international cooperation, not individual action, that it will solve global challenges most effectively.
International cooperation, not individual action, that will solve global challenges most effectively.
items.correctAnswer: It is international cooperation, not individual action, that will solve global challenges most effectively.
items.feedbackCorrect: Câu kết Task 2 đỉnh cao! IT-cleft với đối lập 'not individual action'. 'That will solve' (không which, không that it). Band 7.0!
items.feedbackWrong: IT-cleft: It is + [A, not B] + that + [verb phrase]. Dùng 'that' (không 'which'). Không lặp đại từ. Cần 'It is' ở đầu câu.
items.ieltsTip: Cleft với đối lập: 'It is X, NOT Y, that...' — cấu trúc phản biện cực ấn tượng để kết luận Task 2. Dùng một lần trong bài thi!

writingMini.prompt: Viết 1-2 câu kết Task 2 dùng IT-cleft hoặc WH-cleft nhấn mạnh giải pháp cho vấn đề toàn cầu.
writingMini.placeholder: Ví dụ: It is collective global action, not isolated national policies, that will...
writingMini.modelAnswer: It is collective global action, not isolated national policies, that will ultimately determine whether humanity can address the pressing challenges of poverty, inequality, and climate change.

speakingDrill.prompt: Part 3: 'What is the most important thing the world needs to solve global problems?' Dùng IT-cleft hoặc WH-cleft.
speakingDrill.modelAnswer: What the world most urgently needs is a fundamental shift in political priorities, away from short-term gains and towards long-term sustainability. It is the lack of genuine political will, not the absence of solutions, that has allowed problems like poverty and climate change to persist. What gives me hope is the growing global movement of young people demanding meaningful action.
